body.label: Target
body.html: Self; a nearby loose object or noisy surface.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Create a brief mundane distraction and move up to 3 units. You can become Hidden only if you end in actual concealment and meet the normal hiding rules.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
One willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward cover.

rider.title: Contingency - Evasion
rider.html: When an enemy leaves its cover to pursue you before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that movement.
